hook.name: QSimpleLaunch
hook.description: Launch factory and pool hook for QHooks that deploys standalone ERC-20 tokens and Uniswap v4 pools. Implements trading guards (anti-snipe, holder gate, cooldown, block buy cap) and fee splits (buyback/burn, protocol fees, optional referrals via hookData), with a permanently held bonding position. No owner, upgrade, or pause.
